chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, who said:
“The verse of zakat was sent down to him:
‘Take charity from their wealth by which you purify them and cause them to grow by it.’

in the month of Ramadan. So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم commanded his caller, and he proclaimed among the people: ‘Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has made zakat obligatory upon you just as He made salat (prayer) obligatory upon you. So Allah has made obligatory upon you concerning gold, silver, camels, cattle, sheep, and from wheat, barley, dates, and raisins.’ And he proclaimed that among them in the month of Ramadan, and he excused them from what was besides that.”

He said: “Then he did not address anything from their wealth until the year had passed over them by the following year. Then they fasted and broke the fast, so he عليه السلام commanded his caller, and he proclaimed among the Muslims: ‘O Muslims, give the zakat of your wealth so that your salat (prayer) may be accepted.’”
He said: “Then he dispatched the workers of charity and the workers of al-ṭusūq.”

key_terms.تُزَكِّيهِمْ: Causes them to grow or purifies them further through the charity.
key_terms.تُطَهِّرُهُمْ: Purifies them, meaning it cleanses the givers through giving.
key_terms.صَدَقَةً: Charitable due taken from wealth here in the sense of obligatory zakat.
key_terms.ٱلذَّهَبِ: Gold, one of the wealth categories upon which zakat was imposed.
key_terms.ٱلزَّكَاةِ: The obligatory alms due on specified forms of wealth.
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةَ: The obligatory salat (prayer), mentioned here alongside zakat as a prescribed duty.
key_terms.ٱلْحَوْلُ: The passing of a full year, relevant to the timing of zakat liability.

ai.seo_question: When was the verse of zakat revealed, and on which kinds of wealth was zakat made obligatory?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that the verse commanding zakat was revealed in Ramadan and that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم publicly announced its obligation upon specific categories of wealth. It also shows that collection was deferred until a full year had passed, after which zakat officials were sent out, indicating an organized and legislated system of zakat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1598 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub reported from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The verse of Zakat was revealed: 
'Take alms from their wealth to purify them and cleanse them with it' (Surah At-Tawbah 9:103), 
in the Month of Ramadan. The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, ordered his announcer to proclaim to the people: 'Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has made Zakat obligatory upon you as He has made prayer obligatory upon you. Allah (swt) has prescribed Zakat for gold, silver, camels, cows, sheep, wheat, barley, dates, and raisins.' He announced this during the Month of Ramadan and exempted them from everything else."
The Imam continued:
"Then he did not take anything from their wealth until a full year had passed. When the following year came, they fasted and broke their fast. Then the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him, ordered his announcer to call out among the Muslims:
'O Muslims, pay the Zakat of your wealth so that your prayers may be accepted.'
He then sent out collectors for Zakat and tax collectors."
